name: io.github.tastytrade/tastytrade-mcp
title: tastytrade
description: Agent access to tastytrade brokerage accounts: quotes, positions, and dry-run-gated order flow.

toolSurface.note: Every destructive tool requires a single-use confirmation token issued by its matching dry_run_* tool, valid for 60 seconds and bound to a hash of the submitted arguments.

install.note: Install by cloning and building. This server publishes no container image and is not published to npm, so there is no docker pull and no npx invocation. A Dockerfile is included for anyone who wants to build their own image.

cloneAndBuild.description: Clone the repository, build it, and point your MCP client at the compiled entrypoint.
notes: args must be an absolute path; MCP clients do not resolve ~ or relative paths.
A .env file in the repository is NOT auto-loaded. Credentials must come from the client's env block, or be exported in the launching shell.

rateLimits.scheme: Per-second. These are tastytrade's published request limits, enforced in-process and charged once per tool call.
rateLimits.howItApplies: Every call is charged against the global cap; a call reaching one of the endpoints above is charged against that endpoint's ceiling as well. Tools that are not in the table carry no per-endpoint ceiling, except that the twelve destructive tools are additionally rate-limited by an internal safety cap: a burst of order submissions or cancellations can be refused while the global cap still has room. That cap is a backstop rather than a published budget, so it is not quoted here and a refusal does not name it. Exhaustion returns a rate_limit_exceeded ToolError carrying retry_after_ms.
rateLimits.planningNote: A bucket holds one second of budget, so a 1/sec endpoint permits one call and then a full second of waiting; there is nothing to burst through. Size a polling loop per endpoint rather than per agent, and stream live prices over DXLink instead of polling for them.

notes: The API host defaults to the sandbox. Point TASTYTRADE_API_URL at https://api.tastyworks.com only when you intend to trade real money.
Set TASTYTRADE_READ_ONLY=true to withhold every write and destructive tool.
MAX_ORDER_NOTIONAL_USD caps single-order buying-power impact; the default is 50000.

An unrecognised host in TASTYTRADE_API_URL is a startup refusal rather than a warning: the server exits non-zero rather than POST the refresh token and client secret to a host it does not recognise. TASTYTRADE_ALLOW_UNKNOWN_API_HOST=<hostname> acknowledges one by name, for a proxy or a gateway.
A resources/read is charged the same per-endpoint ceilings as the tool that reaches the same endpoint, plus the global cap at the template's declared fan-out.
